text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，加强负面清单管理，原则上停止新建、改扩建以下煤矿：山西、内蒙古、陕西、新疆（除南疆外）产能低于120万吨/年的煤矿，宁夏产能低于60万吨/年的煤矿，其他地区产能低于30万吨/年的煤矿。停止新建产能低于90万吨/年的煤与瓦斯突出、冲击地压、水文地质类型极复杂的煤矿。停止新建第一水平开采深度超1000米和改扩建开采深度超1200米的煤矿，停止新建和改扩建开采深度超过600米的小型煤矿。禁止在生态保护红线、自然保护地、饮用水水源保护区等生态敏感区内规划新建煤矿。
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which states that negative list management will be strengthened, with new construction or renovation of the following coal mines generally stopped: mines in Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, and Xinjiang (excluding southern Xinjiang) with capacity below 1.2 million tons/year, mines in Ningxia with capacity below 600,000 tons/year, and mines in other regions with capacity below 300,000 tons/year. New construction of coal and gas outburst, rock burst, or extremely complex hydrogeological mines with capacity below 900,000 tons/year will be stopped. New mines with first-level mining depth exceeding 1,000 meters and renovation projects with depth exceeding 1,200 meters will be stopped, as will new construction and renovation of small mines exceeding 600 meters in depth. New coal mines will be prohibited in ecological red lines, nature reserves, drinking water source protection zones, and other ecologically sensitive areas.
